title: La Red de Janitzio, VISTA STORIES
comment: red-janitzio (VISTA): muelle de pescadores frente a la isla de Janitzio, lago de Pátzcuaro, Michoacán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.SEVERO_TZINTZUN: Purépecha Mexican fisherman from Michoacán, 78 years old, thin, dark-brown deeply wrinkled skin, short white hair, a woven palm hat, a faded white cotton shirt, rolled-up dark trousers, sandals, his hands empty.
chars.NAYELI_TZINTZUN: Mexican woman, 25 years old, brown skin, long straight black hair in a ponytail, a beige trench coat over a black t-shirt, jeans, white sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.IGNACIO_BARRAGAN: Mexican man, 38 years old, light-brown skin, gelled black hair, a thin mustache, a blue windbreaker jacket with no logo over a white polo shirt, khaki trousers, a silver watch, holding a clipboard.
chars.GOBERNADOR_ARREOLA: Mexican politician, 50 years old, tall, light-brown skin, neat black hair with grey temples, clean-shaven, a dark navy suit with a white shirt and no tie, black shoes, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_MUELLEJANITZIO: Wooden fishermen's dock on Lake Pátzcuaro, Michoacán, in the cold misty morning: small wooden canoes tied along the dock, piles of old fishing nets, the island of Janitzio with its houses in the distance across the calm lake, reeds, pine hills, soft grey light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
